description:
Affected extension: status-line.ex
Upstream: ctx.ui.setStatus(id, text) takes a named slot ID and text. Multiple extensions can each own a named slot; the footer renders all active slots. A single extension calling setStatus repeatedly updates only its own slot without clobbering others.
Current workaround: UIContext.set_status is (String.t() -> :ok) — single-arg, no slot ID. The status-line.ex example calls set_status.("Turn #{turn}...") which works in isolation but would conflict with any other extension also calling set_status.
What's needed: UIContext.set_status signature changed to (id :: String.t(), text :: String.t() -> :ok). The footer render must maintain a map of id → text and render all active slots. Clearing a slot can use set_status(id, nil) or a dedicated clear_status(id) call. Existing callers must be updated to pass a slot id.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/status-line.ts (ctx.ui.setStatus('status-demo', ...))
title: ctx.ui.set_status named slot — set_status(id, text) vs single-string set_status(text)
